name: What should I look for when choosing a bathroom renovation contractor?

mainEntity.name: What should I look for when choosing a bathroom renovation contractor?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a contractor, prioritize experience with similar projects, valid licensing and insurance, and a strong portfolio of completed work. Look for clear communication, detailed proposals, and positive client testimonials. Ensure they understand local building codes and can manage the project efficiently. A reputable contractor will provide transparent pricing and a clear contract outlining all aspects of the renovation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor based on experience, licensing, insurance, portfolio, clear communication, detailed proposals, and positive testimonials.
